selection_authority.rule: Select the lowest frozen enrollment_position strictly greater than 3 that remains objectively materializable under the pre-existing enrollment record. No new candidate search or discretionary draw is permitted while a frozen enrolled position remains materializable.
selection_authority.rationale: The verdict-blind enrollment predates E1 and Unit003 outcome observation. Re-drawing from a contemporary candidate universe would add post-result selection discretion and weaken the held-out design.

candidate_universe.definition: The already-frozen enrolled rows after position 3 in corpus/0.1/ENROLLMENT.json, in their frozen order.

allowed_prebinding_checks: frozen enrollment row exists and is structurally well-formed
named public repository or artifact locator resolves
exact enrolled revision can be addressed or materialized
no duplicate of an already-scored enrollment position
forbidden_prebinding_checks: whether E1 is likely to produce a decisive prediction
whether the target appears preserved or regressed
whether the target has an easy witness
whether source semantics are easy to reconstruct

ineligibility_and_substitution.allowed_only_if: Before semantic-content inspection, the frozen row is objectively non-materializable or structurally invalid under the pre-existing enrollment record.
required_before_substitution: commit an INELIGIBILITY_RECORD.json identifying the frozen position and objective reason
attest that no target semantic content or E1 prediction was observed for that position
advance only to the next frozen enrollment_position
forbidden_reasons: E1 returns or is expected to return ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE
E1 appears likely to miss the mechanism

round_0.purpose: Produce deterministic acquisition seeds without semantic-content inspection.

stop_when: E1 emits a sealed prediction under its frozen rules
E1 reaches its frozen acquisition/refinement budget

claim_boundary.protocol_freeze_establishes_only: Prospective selection and acquisition rules for Unit004 under frozen E1.
does_not_establish: Unit004 target identity until TARGET_BINDING.json is committed
